//: Blocking typecheck for the Vercel routing middleware (middleware.ts) and its route-policy helper. middleware.ts lives at the repo root, outside the main src/** typecheck scope, and is compiled ONLY by Vercel's Edge build — invisible to `npm run build` and the SPA typecheck. This config catches problems (e.g. importing the non-existent 'next/server') locally and in CI. Run via `npm run typecheck:middleware`.
